title: Flood of Opportunities in Ecological Preservation

sentences.text: Flood of Opportunities in Ecological Preservation
For many years, China has worked on an idea called ecological civilization.
It means China should protect nature and build cities, farms, and businesses together.
Today, this idea helps the country face climate change in practical daily ways.
Rainfall patterns are changing across the country.
Some northern places now get more rain, while some areas near the Yangtze River get less.
Because the weather is getting warmer, strong storms and floods happen more often.
This brings new problems, but it also creates some new chances.
In parts of the north, more rain is helping lakes and wetlands recover.
In Inner Mongolia, some water areas are becoming healthier again with better care of land and water.
These changes can help farming, animals, and local jobs.
Cities are also learning to use rainwater better.
Some cities are building "sponge city" programs so rain can go into the ground instead of causing floods.
This shows that protecting nature can also support people's lives and future growth.
